description: The first touch of DLCworkshop01's strings is a new one: a description set where the record had none, before any localized value of the plugin was read. The release's AddValue does not load the tables in DLCworkshop01 - Main.ba2 (only GetValue calls LoadForFile): it makes three new, empty tables, the description gets ID 1, and the save writes a .DLSTRINGS of 1 string and empty .STRINGS and .ILSTRINGS over the plugin's. That loses every other string of the plugin, so the port does not reproduce it (UPSTREAM-BUG, issue #75): it loads the tables first, and its saves must equal the release's saves of fo4-strings-archive-loaded, where a name is read first.

upstream_bug.reason: AddValue makes empty string tables for a localized plugin none of whose strings was read and the save writes them over the plugin's (issue #75); the port loads the plugin's tables first
